POLITICAL PARTIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Political Parties Act, 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 9th August, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 9‑8‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Political Parties (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4, Act III of 1962

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2000
POLITICAL PARTIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Political Parties Act, 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 9th August, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 9‑8‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:
2. Amendment of section 4, Act III of 1962.‑In the Political
Parties Act, 1962 (III of 1962), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in
section 4, in subsection (2), the full‑stop at the end shall be
substituted by a colon and thereafter the following proviso shall be added,
namely:‑‑
"Provided that a person
shall not be an office‑bearer of a political party if he‑‑
(i) is
disqualified from being elected or chosen as, and from being, a member of the
Majlis‑e‑Shoora (Parliament) under Article 63 of the Constitution
or under any law for the time being in force; or :w:..
(ii) has been
convicted of any criminal offence involving moral turpitude or offence under
the Anti‑Terrorism Act, 1997 or offence involving public order or
morality and sentenced by a Court of law to imprisonment for not less than two
years, unless a period of five years has elapsed since his release.".

Substitution of section 7, Act III of 1962

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2000
POLITICAL PARTIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Political Parties Act, 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 9th August, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 9‑8‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:
3. Substitution of section 7, Act III of 1962.‑‑(1) In the
said Act, for section 7, the following shall be substituted, namely:
7. Penalty.‑‑(i)
Any person who being disqualified to be an office bearer of a political party
under this Act or who has been convicted of any criminal offence and sentenced
by a Court of law as mentioned in clause (ii) of proviso to subsection (2) of
section 4 of the Act as stated above, acts or holds himself out as office‑bearer
of that party shall be guilty of an offence punishable with imprisonment for a
term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
(2) Any person
who, after the dissolution of a political party under section 6, holds himself
out as a member or office‑bearer of that party, or acts for, or otherwise associates himself
with, that party, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may
extend to three years, or with fine, or with both
(3) If any
person who was an office‑bearer of a political party at the time of its
dissolution under subsection (2) of section 6 indulges or takes part in any
political activity within seven years of its dissolution, he shall be
punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, or
with fine, or with both."
